basic_info.description: Perfectly situated in vibrant Duboce Triangle, this impeccably renovated Edwardian condo offers a seamless blend of historic character and stunning modern style. Inside, enjoy a sleek, remodeled kitchen featuring high-end appliances, including built-in refrigerator and dishwasher, Miele cooktop, oven, and microwave. Bay windows invite natural light into elegant living spaces, complemented by custom built-in cabinetry and a striking fireplace. The spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom layout also includes a dedicated office, ideal for today's flexible living. The three generously sized bedrooms all include spacious closets and large windows. Two updated bathrooms, including the primary en suite bathroom, feature stylish finishes. Step outside to a private deck overlooking a shared garden - ideal for entertaining, morning coffee, or an evening unwind. Add'l amenities include central heating and AC via electric heat pump, in-unit stacked washer/dryer, private storage, Schlage Smart Lock, Nest Smoke + CO Detectors, and 1-car garage parking with EV charging capability. This home is an easy walk to Duboce & Dolores Parks, and the great dining, local cafes, nightlife, and easy commuting options at the cusp of Duboce Triangle, Mission Dolores, and the Castro. This is city living at its finest!
